Mario's Auto Sales & Rentals

Last updated: October 12, 2026

This policy explains what information Mario's Auto Sales & Rentals ("we", "us") collects when you use this website, and how we use it.

Information we collect

  • Messages you send us. When you tap a WhatsApp button, you leave this site and talk to us on WhatsApp. We see your name, phone number and whatever you write, such as the car you are asking about.
  • Basic usage data. Like most websites, our hosting and analytics tools may record your browser type, device, pages visited and approximate location (city level). This helps us see which cars people look at.

How we use it

  • To answer your questions about a car, a trade-in or a visit.
  • To improve the website and the cars we show.

We do not sell your personal information. We only share it with service providers that help us run the site (such as hosting and analytics), or when the law requires it.

WhatsApp

Conversations on WhatsApp are also covered by WhatsApp's own privacy policy. We only use your number to reply to you, unless you ask us to keep you posted about new cars.

Your choices

You can ask us to delete your messages or contact details at any time by writing to us on WhatsApp or calling (978) 417-4036.

Contact

Mario's Auto Sales & Rentals, 1336 Merrimack Ave, Dracut, MA 01826 · (978) 417-4036

By using this website you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

Vehicle listings

  • We work to keep every listing accurate, but photos, mileage, equipment and other details may contain errors. Please confirm all details with us before you buy.
  • All vehicles are subject to prior sale. A car shown on the site may already be sold.

Prices

Advertised prices include all dealer fees. They do not include Massachusetts sales tax, title and registration fees, which are added at the time of sale. Prices may change without notice until a sale is agreed in writing.

Warranty

Eligible used vehicles sold by us are covered by the Massachusetts Used Vehicle Warranty Law (M.G.L. c. 90, § 7N¼). The coverage period depends on the car's mileage at the time of sale. Your written warranty and the Buyers Guide on the vehicle are the final terms.

No online sales

This site is for information only. No purchase, deposit or financing agreement is made through the website. A sale is final only when both parties sign the purchase documents at our location.

Links

Buttons that open WhatsApp or Google Maps take you to services we do not control. Their own terms apply there.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.

Mario's Auto Sales & Rentals wants everyone, including people with disabilities, to be able to browse our cars and contact us easily.

Our goal

We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, level AA. That includes text descriptions for photos, readable color contrast, buttons large enough to tap, and a site that works with a keyboard and screen readers.

Known limits

Some content comes from other services, such as WhatsApp and Google Maps, and may not be fully accessible. We keep improving the site as we find issues.

Need help?

If any part of this website is hard to use, please let us know and we will help you directly, by phone or in person:

  • Phone: (978) 417-4036
  • Visit: 1336 Merrimack Ave, Dracut, MA 01826

Please tell us the page and the problem you ran into. We will reply as soon as we can.
